reasoning_content: The composer run si didn't actually run? Let me check. The process count 7 was grep itself. Let me run directly and capture. Actually nohup with su may not have run because the log is empty. Let me run in foreground with timeout.

action.command: su ddevuser -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/bin && timeout 500 ddev composer run si 2>&1 | tail -40'; echo "EXIT ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
